title: Prologue: Escape Velocity (Movements I–III — Earth to the Stars)
description: Chronicling the first three movements of the 15-minute progressive rock suite 'Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)': departing the subterranean limestone hangar beneath The Fortress on Industrial Park Road in Blacksburg, Virginia (Movement I: The Cage), roaring into the night sky through Main Engine Cutoff (Movement II: Ignition), and spending three days in FTL Harmonic Continuum transit where Ryan unbuckles his multipoint wheelchair harness to float weightlessly in the starlight of the nebula streams (Movement III: The Cosmos).
